newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki up with strong dollar, bonds, Amer shines.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki up with strong dollar, bonds, Amer shines.

text.p: Shares joined bonds in shrugging off an early bearish response to the leftist win in France's election and were helped by a stronger dollar, brokers said on Monday.
The FOX index put on 1.89 percent to 1,067 with the HEX adding 1.88 percent to 3,082, in solid overall volume around 655 million markka.
"The effect from the French elections was surprisingly small, but there still are some risks and people are waiting to see the new French government's comments on EMU," one said.

Amer, suspended for most of the session, volleyed to a new year-high in the last half hour in initial enthusiasm for a plan by British investor Jonathan Bryan Guinness, third Lord Moyne, to buy control from Finnish institutional investors.
Amer's stock closed at 107.00 markka, up 6.00 markka or nearly six percent, after at one stage hitting 116.50.
Orion also broke a year-high 211 markka after it won clearance to sell its Fareston breast cancer drug in the United States. It closed up 9.00 or over four percent at 209.00.
Nokia put on 9.30 markka to 345.50, recovering ground lost on a profit-warning from Intel on Friday.
